title: James Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on James 5: the warning to the rich, the patience of the farmer, and prayer in the assembly.

questions.text: Who are told in verse 1 to weep and howl for the miseries coming on them?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

questions.text: What has happened to their gold and their silver, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says their gold and silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against them.

questions.text: Whose cries have entered the ears of the Lord of Armies?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says the wages of the laborers who mowed their fields cry out, and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

answers.text: The laborers who mowed their fields

questions.text: What does the farmer in verse 7 wait for?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it.

answers.text: The precious fruit of the earth
The prayer of a righteous man

questions.text: Who are given in verse 10 as an example of suffering and perseverance?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says: take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

questions.text: Whose perseverance does verse 11 say they have heard of?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says: you have heard of the perseverance of Job, and have seen the Lord in the outcome.

questions.text: According to verse 12, how should they speak instead of swearing?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don't fall into hypocrisy.

answers.text: They should swear by the earth
They should take one oath only

questions.text: Whom should the sick person among them call for?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says: is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.

questions.text: How long did it not rain after Elijah prayed earnestly?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says Elijah prayed that it might not rain, and it didn't rain on the earth for three years and six months.

questions.text: What does the one who turns a sinner from the error of his way do, according to verse 20?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.

answers.text: He receives a crown of gold
He saves a soul from death
